cold_os_operator.status: Awaiting root final freeze/execution receipt; no cold app run by this analyzer agent.

matching_contract.identity: Non-echo pressed physical key name, or mouse button and viewport x/y within2px.
matching_contract.qualification: Only a unique complete contiguous ordered signature alignment is accepted; no time lower bound or latency cutoff. Ambiguous candidates and incomplete insertion/deletion sequences are not force-matched.
matching_contract.latency_acceptance: OS_command_to_matched_OS_event_received and OS_command_to_matched_OS_event_frame_post_draw are NOT_VALIDATED_CLOCK_ALIGNMENT. No command p95/PASS is inferred from one initial clock sync.
matching_contract.residuals: Signed cross-clock residuals, including all negative values, remain diagnostic. No clipping, negative removal, offset fitting or clock calibration is invented.
matching_contract.valid_metric: Engine os_input_received to os_event_frame_post_draw_feedback elapsed_ms pairs use event_id within one engine clock; this is engine rendering feedback, not physical display/pixel presentation.
matching_contract.scope_counts: All unmatched, ambiguous, release, echo, missing feedback and phase-boundary counts are retained.

observed_f5_method_failure.interpretation: Observed clock-projection drift broke the old timestamp-greedy matcher. Its very long assigned delays are method-error history, not validated game input latency.

process_and_probe_scope.first_process: Top-level journey trace only; no restart duplication.
process_and_probe_scope.restart_process: restart-frame-timeline read once with its own sync; no cross-process frame intervals.
process_and_probe_scope.cold_resume_probe: Each20s process leg is an independent child OS report. Not1800s play, cold physical-disk, native or target-device certification.
process_and_probe_scope.host_environment: Find closest existing HOST_ENVIRONMENT.json in ancestors; wrapper binds the same actual file.
process_and_probe_scope.capture_comparison: Only actual recording comparison markers/controlled flag determine text. An absent comparison is NOT_RUN_IN_THIS_SESSION; separate controlled preflight is distinct evidence.

app_execution: No app replay by analyzer work. Root owns exclusive cold/store probes.
